body.cap: Kim Jin-wook, CEO of MindLogic, at the booth with the technology demo in CES 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: MindLogic (CEO Kim Jin-wook and Kim Yong-woo) participated in CES 2024, the world’s largest electronics and IT expo held in Las Vegas from the 9th to the 12th (local time).

Under the slogan ‘Creating AI that people want to talk more with,’ MindLogic has developed and provided commercial chatbot services based on generative AI. Their social AI metaverse chat platform, ‘OpenTown,’ has proven highly popular in the market, ranking 6th in the social category of ‘2022 Koreans’ favorite Mobile Apps’.

Additionally, among the services currently offered by MindLogic are the following: △ Corporate solution ‘MindLogic Chat API,’ which combines ChatGPT and MindLogic’s conversation engine △ All-in-One Virtubing Solution ‘OpenTown Studio’ △ 1:1 English talk service ‘Deep Learning English’ through AI tutors.
In addition to various AI services aimed at global market entry, MindLogic showcased its chat API service at CES 2024, leading a promotional strategy for user expansion.

MindLogic Chat API is characterized by its unique ‘Persona Chatbot,’ offering differentiated functionality and personality compared to existing services like ChatGPT. The company’s proprietary technology minimizes the risk of hallucination, a persistent issue in generative AI, enhancing the reliability of the information provided by chatbots.

Simultaneously, the ability to remember the user’s name and conversation content for an extended period, along with supporting voice conversations beyond text-based communication, enables the formation of a sense of connection between the chatbot and the user, according to the company’s explanation.

Moreover, the Persona Chatbot can be easily installed on specific web pages using a plugin method without a separate development process. It also provides a console system for administrators to check and manage user communication content easily.

body.cap: Kim Jin-wook, CEO of MindLogic, interviewing with Jay Kennedy Marcus, a reporter from AVING News, at CES 2024 in Las Vegas on the 9th (local time) | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Kim Jin-wook, CEO of MindLogic, expressed satisfaction, stating, “From the name ‘Persona Chatbot,’ we were able to meet many global attendees who showed interest in our product.” He added, “Especially the positive responses from potential partners willing to collaborate on providing and expanding services in North America, beyond end-users, are one of the achievements of participating in CES, making us pleased to establish a foundation for substantial revenue generation.”

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is held in Las Vegas every January, providing a comprehensive view of global technology industry trends. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been selecting the best innovative products, companies, and technologies and conducting ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA’ selections. Additionally, through ‘AVING LIVE,’ they provide live coverage of CES issues.

The CES 2024 Seoul Pavilion operated on the most historical scale since Seoul’s first participation in CES in 2020, with the largest exhibition area, number of participating companies, and supporter numbers. Seoul Metropolitan Government collaborated with 13 institutions to design The Seoul Pavilion, which is essential in Seoul’s endeavors to establish Seoul as a startup hub. Among the participating companies in the Seoul Pavilion, 17 received innovation awards, proving their capabilities. Collaborated institutions include Seoul Business Agency, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul Campus Town, Yangjae Innovation Hub, Gwanak-gu, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, and Kyunghee University, totaling 13. Seoul City and institutions and supporters participating in industry-academic cooperation are matched 1:1 with companies, with a maximum of 85 supporters participating.
